description: Character counter for TweetProcessing with Twitter-style counting
config.title: TweetProcessing Counter
config.label.description: Unit to display after character count (leave empty for auto: ja=文字, en=chars)
config.lineBreakCount.actual: Actual character count (LF=1 char, CRLF=2 chars)
config.lineBreakCount.single: Always count line breaks as 1 character
config.warningThreshold.description: Show warning when character count exceeds this number (0 to disable)
